flagged.title: Angels, Predestination and Akhirah
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims angels are not pictured with wings in Islamic theology (contradicting the specification text of Surah 35:1) and misdefines the key Arabic term 'taqdeer' as a theological mystery.

mark_affecting.quote: And while the Quran occasionally uses figurative language, Islamic theology doesn't usually picture them with physical human forms or big feathery wings like you might see in some other traditions.
just kind of coexist as this deep theological mystery. They call it taqdeer.
